## Summary

What problem does this solve, and why is this the smallest complete change?

## Correctness and security

Describe ordering, overflow, authorization, lifecycle, and fallback effects.

## Validation

- [ ] GCC warning-clean build
- [ ] Clang warning-clean build
- [ ] Relevant tests
- [ ] ASan/UBSan where applicable
- [ ] No drops, gaps, duplication/reordering, or invalid ACKs in ordinary runs

## Performance evidence

For performance changes, provide before/after raw evidence, exact environment,
commands, percentiles, and evidence class. Write “not applicable” otherwise.

## Licensing

- [ ] Original contribution is MIT-compatible
- [ ] Third-party code/patch attribution and licensing are preserved
